title: Pullback and tensor product of invertible modules, and their fibres

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01CD (lemma-tensor-product-pullback: f^*(F (x) G) = f^*F (x) f^*G), Lemma 0B8L (lemma-pullback-invertible), Lemma 0B8K (lemma-invertible: tensor products of invertible modules are invertible); for (3): Sheaves, Lemma 0098 (sheaves-lemma-stalk-pullback-modules: (f^*F)_x = F_{f(x)} (x)_{O_{Y,f(x)}} O_{X,x}) and Modules, Lemma 01CB (lemma-stalk-tensor-product: (F (x) G)_y = F_y (x) G_y)

mathlib_searches.query: pullback of an invertible sheaf of modules is invertible; pullback commutes with tensor product of sheaves of modules on schemes
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: pullback of O_X-modules exists (and pullbackComp gives the composition part of (2)), but no tensor product of sheaves of modules on a scheme and no invertible modules

mathlib_searches.query: invertible module over a scheme (line bundle), tensor product of invertible modules is invertible
mathlib_searches.verdict: no match: only the ring-level statement (invertible modules over a commutative ring, Module.Invertible), not sheaves on a scheme

mathlib_searches.results: monoidal structure only on presheaves of modules (Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf/Monoidal.lean); none on SheafOfModules or Scheme.Modules; no invertible sheaves of modules; AlgebraicGeometry/Modules has Presheaf.lean, Sheaf.lean, Tilde.lean only
